name: Hamilton County Schools
calendarType: Color-coded district calendar with quarter, midterm and report-card dates
seoDescription: Browse Hamilton County Schools calendars by school year, with official English and Spanish PDFs, reviewed student dates, quarter schedules and calendar downloads.
districtFact: HCS annual calendars use color to distinguish student attendance days, professional development, administrative in-service, paid breaks and unpaid holidays. The same one-page PDF also publishes quarter ranges, midterms and report-card dates.

about.title: Calendar colors change what a date means
about.content: The HCS PDF is more than a list of breaks. Green dates indicate students are in school, blue dates are professional development days, and separate colors identify administrative in-service, paid holidays, Winter Break and unpaid holidays.

about.title: Break dates do not always reveal the return date
about.content: HCS sometimes places professional development immediately after a published break. Each school-year page keeps the official break label and separately identifies when students actually return.

about.title: Quarter dates are published with family milestones
about.content: The district calendar gives quarter ranges and day totals alongside midterm and report-card dates. Those academic dates are kept separate from student holidays and professional development days.

about.title: Spanish calendars are official translations
about.content: HCS publishes Spanish editions beside the English school-year calendars. They are language versions of the district schedule, not separate attendance tracks.

calendarNotes: Use the annual HCS PDF for adopted districtwide dates and the live HCS calendar for current events or later additions. Calendar colors matter: a weekday immediately after a break may be a professional development day rather than a student return date. Red text marks student half-days with early bus release, but the annual PDF does not publish one districtwide dismissal time. School activities, conference schedules and building-specific changes should be confirmed with the assigned school. A MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import and does not update automatically.
